overcame_fear.name: Overcame Fear
overcame_fear.description: A companion faced a serious threat without abandoning their responsibilities.
overcame_fear.memory: Found the resolve to face a feared danger.

protected_companion.name: Shielded a Companion
protected_companion.description: A companion deliberately placed themselves in danger to protect an ally.
protected_companion.memory: Protected a companion when it mattered.

ancient_study.name: Studied an Ancient Text
ancient_study.description: A companion completed a meaningful study of a difficult historical or scholarly text.
ancient_study.memory: Made progress understanding an ancient text.

kept_oath.name: Kept a Consequential Oath
kept_oath.description: A companion honoured a promise despite a meaningful personal cost.

broken_oath.name: Broke a Consequential Oath
broken_oath.description: A companion knowingly broke a solemn promise. Context and player choice must establish responsibility.
broken_oath.memory: Broke a solemn promise and must live with the consequences.

shared_bounty.name: Shared the Spoils
shared_bounty.description: A companion willingly shared a meaningful reward with the company.
shared_bounty.memory: Shared a hard-earned reward with companions.

hoarded_bounty.name: Kept the Greater Share
hoarded_bounty.description: A companion repeatedly chose personal gain over an agreed fair share.
hoarded_bounty.memory: Chose personal gain over the company's agreed share.

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine Milestone
field_medicine.description: A companion repeatedly treated allies in dangerous field conditions.
field_medicine.memory: Helped keep the company alive through field medicine.

survived_expedition.name: Survived a Harsh Expedition
survived_expedition.description: A companion completed a difficult expedition with scarce supplies or severe conditions.

battle_veteran.name: Battle Veteran
battle_veteran.description: A companion has survived a meaningful series of dangerous battles.

precision_shooting.name: Precision Shooting
precision_shooting.description: A ranged fighter repeatedly demonstrated careful, accurate marksmanship.
precision_shooting.memory: Improved aim through repeated disciplined practice.

sword_mastery.name: Sword Mastery
sword_mastery.description: A sword user completed sustained practice and demonstrated skill in a meaningful duel.
sword_mastery.memory: Advanced their swordsmanship through practice and a difficult duel.

repeated_betrayal.name: Betrayed by a Trusted Ally
repeated_betrayal.description: A companion experienced a confirmed betrayal by someone they trusted.
repeated_betrayal.memory: Was betrayed by a trusted ally.

personal_failure.name: Personal Failure
personal_failure.description: A companion suffered a consequential personal setback.

reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: A meaningful conflict was addressed through apology, repair, and renewed trust.
reconciliation.memory: A difficult relationship began to heal through reconciliation.

lost_companion.name: Loss of a Companion
lost_companion.description: A companion suffered a major personal loss. This event should be authored carefully and never triggered repeatedly.
lost_companion.memory: Suffered the loss of a close companion.

maren_returned_log.name: The Last Sounding
maren_returned_log.description: Maren recovered the final log of the Northstar crew and chose to keep it with those who shared the loss.
maren_returned_log.memory: Recovered the Northstar's last sounding and entrusted its log to the company.

maren_published_log.name: A Beacon's Truth
maren_published_log.description: Maren allowed the Northstar's final log to be read by the beacon crews.
maren_published_log.memory: Allowed the Northstar's final sounding to be made public for the sake of the beacon crews.

neris_route_published.name: The Second Beacon Published
neris_route_published.description: Neris allowed the hidden route to be shared with the Tidebound Assembly.
neris_route_published.memory: Published the hidden beacon route so merchant ships could use it.

neris_route_private.name: A Route Kept for the Coast
neris_route_private.description: Neris kept the hidden route for the local fishers rather than the Assembly.
neris_route_private.memory: Kept the second beacon route for the fishers who protected the coast.

defended_the_fallen.name: Defended the Fallen
defended_the_fallen.description: A companion held position to protect wounded allies instead of pursuing an easy victory.
defended_the_fallen.memory: Held the line so wounded companions could survive.

spared_a_defeated_enemy.name: Mercy After Victory
spared_a_defeated_enemy.description: A companion deliberately spared a defeated foe when execution was possible.
spared_a_defeated_enemy.memory: Chose mercy when the defeated enemy could no longer fight.

executed_a_surrendered_foe.name: Blood on the Surrendered
executed_a_surrendered_foe.description: A companion knowingly executed a surrendered enemy. The story must establish that the character had a genuine choice.
executed_a_surrendered_foe.memory: Carried the memory of executing a foe who had surrendered.

taught_a_companion.name: Passing on Hard-Won Knowledge
taught_a_companion.description: A companion patiently mentored another character through a meaningful training milestone.
taught_a_companion.memory: Shared hard-won knowledge with a companion.

mastered_a_difficult_skill.name: Mastered a Difficult Skill
mastered_a_difficult_skill.description: A companion repeatedly practised and successfully used a demanding combat technique.
mastered_a_difficult_skill.memory: Turned difficult practice into reliable battlefield skill.

stood_against_superior_force.name: Stood Against Superior Numbers
stood_against_superior_force.description: A companion held against a substantially stronger force and survived through deliberate action.
stood_against_superior_force.memory: Held their ground against superior numbers.

repeatedly_abandoned_allies.name: Left Behind
repeatedly_abandoned_allies.description: A companion repeatedly abandoned allies in avoidable danger. A tactical retreat or obeyed command never qualifies.
repeatedly_abandoned_allies.memory: Remembered leaving companions in danger when help was possible.

kept_a_dangerous_secret.name: The Weight of a Secret
kept_a_dangerous_secret.description: A companion deliberately kept a consequential secret to protect another person or the company.
kept_a_dangerous_secret.memory: Carried a difficult secret for the sake of someone else.

resolved_a_faction_dispute.name: Brokered a Difficult Peace
resolved_a_faction_dispute.description: A companion helped resolve a serious dispute between factions without coercion.
resolved_a_faction_dispute.memory: Helped prevent a conflict through patient negotiation.

led_a_successful_expedition.name: Led the Expedition Home
led_a_successful_expedition.description: A companion successfully led multiple dangerous expeditions while keeping the company supplied.
led_a_successful_expedition.memory: Brought the company safely through a difficult expedition.

completed_a_masterwork.name: A Masterwork Forged
completed_a_masterwork.description: A companion completed a demanding craft project using rare materials and a proven design.
completed_a_masterwork.memory: Completed a piece of work worthy of lasting recognition.

discovered_a_lost_route.name: Found the Forgotten Road
discovered_a_lost_route.description: A companion mapped and verified a previously unknown route through dangerous territory.
discovered_a_lost_route.memory: Found a safe passage through country few dared to cross.

survived_a_magical_catastrophe.name: Survived the Arcane Rupture
survived_a_magical_catastrophe.description: A companion survived direct exposure to a dangerous magical event. This requires an authored supernatural encounter.
survived_a_magical_catastrophe.memory: Survived a violent rupture in the natural order.

purified_a_cursed_relic.name: Purified a Cursed Relic
purified_a_cursed_relic.description: A companion helped cleanse a cursed relic through an authored ritual and meaningful sacrifice.
purified_a_cursed_relic.memory: Helped cleanse a relic without surrendering to its corruption.

resisted_forbidden_pact.name: Refused the Forbidden Pact
resisted_forbidden_pact.description: A companion rejected an offer of power that threatened their principles or another person's safety.
resisted_forbidden_pact.memory: Refused power that demanded too high a price.

accepted_forbidden_pact.name: Accepted the Forbidden Pact
accepted_forbidden_pact.description: A companion knowingly accepted a dangerous supernatural bargain. The consequence must be authored, not inferred.
accepted_forbidden_pact.memory: Accepted a bargain whose consequences remain uncertain.

recovered_from_trauma.name: A Step Toward Healing
recovered_from_trauma.description: A companion made meaningful progress recovering after a traumatic event through supported story content.
recovered_from_trauma.memory: Took a difficult step toward healing with the support of trusted companions.

accepted_responsibility.name: Accepted Responsibility
accepted_responsibility.description: A companion acknowledged a consequential mistake and took responsibility for repairing its harm.
accepted_responsibility.memory: Chose accountability instead of shifting blame.

betrayed_a_trusted_companion.name: Betrayal of Trust
betrayed_a_trusted_companion.description: A companion knowingly betrayed someone who had placed meaningful trust in them.
betrayed_a_trusted_companion.memory: Broke the trust of someone who had relied on them.

kept_company_through_hardship.name: Stayed Through Hardship
kept_company_through_hardship.description: A companion remained beside an ally through repeated danger and personal cost.
kept_company_through_hardship.memory: Stayed beside a companion when leaving would have been easier.
